test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 22 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A can complete one-sixth of a work in 13 days, B can complete 34% of the same work in 17 days, C can complete one-third of the work in 19 days and D can complete three-fourth of the work in 15 days. Who will be able to complete the work first?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Find full work time:

A ⇒ (1/6) in 13 days ⇒ full = 13 × 6 = 78 days

B ⇒ 34% = 17/50 ⇒ full = 17 ÷ (17/50) = 50 days

C ⇒ (1/3) in 19 days ⇒ full = 19 × 3 = 57 days

D ⇒ (3/4) in 15 days ⇒ full = 15 × (4/3) = 20 days

Least time = 20 days

**∴ Answer = D**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A does 1/6 in 13 days

B does 34% in 17 days

C does 1/3 in 19 days

D does 3/4 in 15 days

**Formula used:**

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time

Time = Total work ÷ Efficiency

**Calculation:**

⇒ A’s rate = (1/6)/13 = 1/78 ⇒ time = 78 days

⇒ B’s rate = (34/100)/17 = (17/50)/17 = 1/50 ⇒ time = 50 days

⇒ C’s rate = (1/3)/19 = 1/57 ⇒ time = 57 days

⇒ D’s rate = (3/4)/15 = 1/20 ⇒ time = 20 days

⇒ Minimum time = 20 days

**∴ The correct answer is D.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Efficiency Concept

More efficiency ⇒ less time

Convert % to fraction before solving

Key Idea

Compare total time taken to complete full work

Quick Tip

Convert all to “time for full work” directly
